latest_news.headline: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill two, first fatalities in more than a week

latest_news.headline: Israel conditions Lebanon withdrawal on Hezbollah disarmament
latest_news.text: Reuters reports Israel will not withdraw from southern Lebanon until Hezbollah is disarmed and ordered preparations for an extended presence. Hezbollah rejects weapons talks before Israeli withdrawal. diplomacy_refused activates alongside continuing diplomacy and ceasefire violations; probability stays at the 95/100 ceiling.

latest_news.headline: Iran and U.S. make competing claims over control of Hormuz
latest_news.text: Reuters reports Iran says the Strait is under its control and management while Washington says the U.S. Navy has total control. latest_news.headline: Israel-Lebanon talks continue while southern strikes persist
latest_news.text: Public reporting says Israel and Lebanon resumed U.S.-hosted talks, while Lebanon condemned fresh Israeli strikes in the south as unlawful. The paired evidence renews both diplomacy_active and ceasefire_violation; the raw/coupled score remains at its 95/100 ceiling.
latest_news.source: Reuters / Al Jazeera / News On AIR

latest_news.headline: Taiwan rehearses communications degradation during defence drill

latest_news.text: AP reports overnight clashes in Taiz killed one government soldier and critically wounded another, while Yemeni artillery targeted Houthi movements in Marib. ceasefire_violation is renewed; no additional probability increment is applied because the tracker already prices sustained fighting and maritime strikes.

latest_news.headline: Ukraine hits fourth Russian refinery in three days
latest_news.text: AP reports Ukrainian drones struck the Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat complex 1,300 km from Ukraine, while Russian attacks with 133 long-range drones killed at least four people in Ukraine. This confirms sustained high-intensity war but does not cross a new configured russia_ukraine signal threshold; risk remains 99.
latest_news.source: Associated Press / Ukrainian and Russian officials

latest_news.headline: U.S. ambassador condemns settler siege in West Bank

latest_news.source: Associated Press / U.S. and Israeli officials

latest_news.headline: North Korea fires another ballistic missile before U.S.-ROK drills

latest_news.headline: RSF renews al-Obeid assault as drones return to Sudanese capital

latest_news.headline: Deadly Red Sea ship attack deepens Houthi blockade pressure
latest_news.text: Reuters reports four crew members were killed in the first deadly Houthi shipping strike of the Iran war, with two rescuers also killed; Red Sea traffic has fallen further and Saudi Red Sea oil exports have gone dark. This renews ceasefire_violation and infrastructure_strike without adding a second probability increment.

latest_news.headline: Iran says no progress on reviving interim U.S. peace framework
latest_news.text: Reuters reports a senior Iranian source said there had been absolutely no progress on reviving the June interim arrangement. Messages still move through mediators, so diplomacy_active remains a live but failing channel; no separate diplomacy_refused threshold is applied.
